scope: Shared mother-site Game/Personal In game. Static figures, source arm-angle/release guide and historical ball-only playback.
dataScope: Existing local 2026 regular-season pitch table, backend .venv read-only

contract.angle: At release relative to horizontal; 0 horizontal, 90 overhead; negatives retained. Not ball-flight elevation or joint Euler rotation.
contract.point: Immutable source release XYZ. Do not move point/path to fit body or recalculate Y from extension.
contract.illustration: Generic normalized silhouette, shoulder anchor and line length explicitly schematic; arm angle plus release cannot uniquely identify shoulder/elbow/torso or real motion.
contract.views: Front/back/side camera transformations only; original handed source X unchanged. Label source angle in declared reference plane rather than screen-projected apparent angle.
contract.missing: Keep available source fields; unavailable angle/point stays missing, never filled with 45 degrees.
contract.averages: Per-pitch first. Future game/pitch-type means labeled with scope/sample/coverage, never substituted for a pitch.
contract.extension: Independent source depth measure; not stride, arm length or measured shoulder location.
